name: Password Entry Remains After Invalid Password
summary: The user submits an invalid password, authentication is rejected, and the password view remains visible with its validation status.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and the identified account is active but the submitted password is invalid

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Invalid password supplied through the test runner's secure settings.

serverInteraction.intent: Attempt password authentication and return a deterministic rejected result without establishing a session.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.continue.email.password remains visible with validation-failed status
